content.title: Sanjay Raut Accuses Rahul Narwekar of Tribal Land Grab
content.caption: Sanjay Raut, a Shiv Sena (UBT) Rajya Sabha MP, accuses Rahul Narwekar, the State Assembly Speaker, of illegally encroaching on tribal land and evicting Katkari tribal families.

slides.heading: Sanjay Raut Accuses Rahul Narwekar of Tribal Land Grab
slides.text: Sanjay Raut, a Shiv Sena (UBT) Rajya Sabha MP, accuses Rahul Narwekar, the State Assembly Speaker, of illegally encroaching on tribal land and evicting Katkari tribal families.

slides.heading: Displacement of Katkari Tribal Families
slides.text: In Raigad district, Maharashtra, Katkari tribal families were forcibly evicted from their homes in Alibaug taluka, Raigad district, on 20 March 2025.

slides.heading: Mr. Raut's Accusations
slides.text: Mr. Raut demands to register a criminal case under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act against Rahul Narwekar for illegally encroaching on tribal land and evicting Katkari tribal families.
